policy.privateSourceRule: Source photos stay outside git; manifest stores only logical private:// asset IDs.
policy.approvalRule: Do not mark a flashcard approved until the canonical character sheet is approved.
policy.generationRule: Every generated card records the character, pose, outfit, and equipment references used.

fixedAttributes.hair: shoulder-length layered bob, dark brown-black, natural center part
fixedAttributes.body: use the teacher reference pack as the authority for proportions; do not slim, lengthen, or stylize the body
fixedAttributes.rendering: educational Pilates illustration, realistic anatomy, neutral professional pose
